QUOTE: `scope` (`_scope_payload`): covered file count, source tier (whole-repo vs declared), extensions, top levels. This is what separates "outside the indexed scope" from "not in the repo". `not_indexed` and `not_indexed_count` are present only when the build recorded them.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes scope and not_indexed fields, but never says the reply names in-scope file types that produced zero rows; that specific mechanism is absent.
